product: commentary — no product. TikTok Shop launch playbook.
hook: "If I was starting a TikTok Shop page today, this is what I would do👇"
body: Pick 3–5 hero products: easy to explain, easy to demo, strong margin, deep inventory. TikTok Shop rewards fast comprehension — if a creator needs 4 paragraphs to explain it, it's the wrong first product. Build the shop to convert first: images, titles, descriptions, variants, pricing, shipping, offers — trust before traffic. Set commissions high: creators are commission-motivated salespeople; weak commission loses the best ones. (Truncated.)
idea: Hero products plus a trustworthy shop plus high commissions equal the TikTok Shop launch foundation.
why_it_works: Affiliates are salespeople — they promote what pays and what converts.
what_to_steal: For LC's TikTok Shop: 3–5 hero SKUs (bestsellers, demoable), shop hygiene first, commissions that beat competitors.
